name: OKC_REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS
description: This table is used to store contract terms during upload from word document.

columns.name: REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS_ID
columns.description: Sequence Id - Primary Key for OKC_REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Id of the business document for which the word document has been uploaded

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Document Type of the business document for which the word document has been uploaded

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description:
Object Id Refers to Cat_id for Clauses Section_id for Sections
Cat_id for Clauses
Section_id for Sections
Object Id Refers to
Cat_id for Clauses
Section_id for Sections

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type to define document. It can be Section or Article

columns.name: OBJECT_TEXT
columns.description: Refers to clause text when the object is clause

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Parent Object. It can be Document or Section.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Object Id of the Parent Object. Object can be Clause or Section.

columns.name: ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Article Id - refers to the id of clause

columns.name: ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Article Version Id refers to the id of the clause version

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Stores the Numbering Sequence which is used for uploading

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQ
columns.description: Display Sequence for the sections and clauses

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: Action Column. 'ADDED','UPDATED','DELETED'. FndLookups.LookupType='OKC_REVIEW_ACTIONS'

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Message Count for Errors that is encountered while uploading for a particular section or clause

columns.name: WARNING_MESSAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Message Count for Warnings that is encountered while uploading for a particular section or clause

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: NON_STANDARD_FLAG
columns.description: Is the Article Non-Standard? Populated as part of Sync Process

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Is the Article Mandatory? Populated as part of Sync Process

columns.name: LOCK_TEXT
columns.description: Is the Article Lock Text Enabled? Populated as part of Sync Process

columns.name: NEW_PARENT_ID
columns.description: New Parent Id . Populated as part of Upload process

columns.name: OBJECT_TITLE
columns.description: it refers to Section or Clause Title

columns.name: UPLOAD_LEVEL
columns.description: It denotes at what level was the Section or Clause identified in the word document.

columns.name: OLD_REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS_ID
columns.description: It stores the original id of the review terms before Merge.

columns.name: TERMS_CHANGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to identify the contract terms thart are changed compared to the terms in the system

columns.name: ARTICLE_TEXT_IN_WORD
columns.description: Clause text in word which is used for upload. It stores the entire word document.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the reviewed uploaded terms

columns.name: CURRENT_CLAUSE_TEXT
columns.description: Current Clause Text of the object clause

columns.name: COMPARE_TO_CURRENT
columns.description: The text of the compared clause to the current clause.

columns.name: COMPARE_TO_STANDARD
columns.description: The text of the compared clause to the standard clause

columns.name: STANDARD_CLAUSE_TEXT
columns.description: The text of the standard clause, if the current clause is non-standard

columns.name: INSERT_BY_REFERENCE
columns.description: It stores the flag to indicate if the clause is inserted by reference.

columns.name: SUPPRESS_SCN_NAME_PRINT
columns.description: Flag to suppress printing of section name

columns.name: SECTION_SKIP_NUMBERING
columns.description: Flag to skip numbering numbering of sections during numbering and printing

columns.name: START_ON_NEW_PAGE
columns.description: Flag to indicate if a section should start on a new page during printing

columns.name: ALIGNMENT
columns.description: Indicator to align section name - left,center or right during printing

columns.name: SUPPRESS_CLAUSE_TITLE_PRINT
columns.description: Flag to suppress printing of clause title

columns.name: CLAUSE_SKIP_NUMBERING
columns.description: Flag to skip numbering of clauses during numbering and printing
